title: An app with no terminal that quits, crashes or is killed leaves no cmux-tui of its sessions 30 s later
why: R-LIFECYCLE ORPHANS: Lawrence's Mac had 380 cmux-tui processes with parent 1 from old tagged DEV apps. Fleet repro on build 3a43a131 (2026-11-04): with no terminal, Cmd-Q, SIGTERM, SIGKILL and a crash all left the app session's owner (cmux-tui --headless --session cmux-app-...), the Chief session's owner (cmux-chief-...) and each one's screen detection plugin running with parent 1; only Quit and End Sessions ended them. The owners keep nothing a person can see: their state is durable and the next launch starts them again. With live terminals and Keep Sessions the owner and its terminal hosts stay by design (pty-holder.md D1), so this journey quits with none.
source: R-LIFECYCLE ORPHANS (handoff/rewrites/R-LIFECYCLE/DESIGN.md section 8), fleet repro rlc-orphans-base-3..6
